power.artifact_power.amount: Number of debuff applications that may be prevented, not debuff magnitude or turns.
power.artifact_power.removal: A qualifying application consumes one charge; remove when charges are spent. It does not cleanse preexisting debuffs.
notes: ApplyPowerAction prevention is per application and depends on technical power type. Named relic prevention and source callbacks have distinct checkpoints; direct addPower is not the same path.

power.strength_power.amount: Signed additive attack-damage modifier; negative Strength is distinct from the delayed Flex/Shackled powers.
notes: Application sign/type and changes of an existing signed amount are not the same as a separate Strength Down identity. Do not universally apply Strength to HP loss, orb damage or triggered THORNS damage.

power.dexterity_power.amount: Signed modifier to calculated card Block, not every source of Block.
notes: Raw power, relic and Frost Block do not automatically receive the card Block calculation. Dexterity Down/DexLoss is a separate delayed-loss power.

power.focus_power.amount: Signed modifier to Lightning/Frost values and future Dark growth; Plasma is unaffected.
notes: Changing Focus does not retroactively change a Dark Orb's already accumulated damage.

power.weak_power.amount: Remaining duration, not the percentage reduction.
notes: The ordinary attack multiplier is 0.75. Paper Krane can change the enemy-side reduction. Do not apply this indiscriminately to HP loss or triggered non-Attack damage.
Initial-application timing, source-monster flags, player/enemy clocks and reapplication require their qualified lifecycle; 'duration' alone does not define when to decrement.

power.vulnerable_power.amount: Remaining duration, not the damage multiplier.
notes: Ordinary Attack damage is multiplied by 1.5. Odd Mushroom and Paper Phrog alter appropriate player/enemy cases. Modifiers and rounding are not a single integer addition.
Do not treat orb, Poison or all triggered damage as Attacks.

power.frail_power.amount: Remaining duration, not the percentage Block penalty.
notes: Ordinary calculated card Block is reduced by 25%; raw power/relic/orb Block is not automatically modified. Turnip and Artifact have application-prevention roles.

power.poison_power.amount: Captured HP-loss payload for the next tick; the current stack is reduced by one after delivery.
power.poison_power.turn_progression: Queue captured-amount HP loss at the afflicted creature's start-turn; the loss action then reduces the currently present Poison by one.
power.poison_power.removal: Reduction removes the current Poison at zero. Prevention, replacement, dead/battle-ending guards and terminal interruption remain distinct.
notes: Poison is HP_LOSS, not an Attack and not Block-reduced. Its afflicted-owner clock is different from Noxious Fumes' player post-draw application clock.
Catalyst requests another application based on action-time Poison; it is not an unconditional direct multiplication of a field.

power.noxious_fumes_power.turn_progression: At player post-draw start-turn, request the stacked amount of Poison separately on eligible enemies.
notes: Not the same event as the enemy's own Poison tick. The draft includes a monsters-basically-dead guard.

power.gain_strength_power.amount: Signed Strength restoration amount, stored separately from the preceding Strength loss.
power.gain_strength_power.removal: At the affected creature's end-turn request Strength restoration and self-removal; cleansing/prevention can break loss/restoration symmetry.
notes: Shackled is technically a DEBUFF despite restoring Strength. Piercing Wail/Dark Shackles have source-specific Artifact-presence capture rules; do not rebuild eligibility after earlier queued applications.

power.lose_strength_power.amount: Strength to lose later, not the creature's current signed Strength.
power.lose_strength_power.removal: Request the delayed Strength loss and removal at its qualified end-turn checkpoint.
notes: Flex's immediate Strength gain and the delayed expiry debuff are separate applications. Preventing/cleansing the latter need not undo the former.

power.lose_dexterity_power.amount: Dexterity to lose at the delayed end-turn checkpoint; not current negative Dexterity.
notes: Keep the temporary gain and its expiry application separate. The exact mixed-relic/copy/end-turn arbitration is not certified by the tooltip.

power.watcher_end_turn_death_power.amount: Nonstacking marker, documented amount -1; not a duration or unconditional defeat instruction.
power.watcher_end_turn_death_power.effect: At the next player start-turn, request 99,999 player-owned HP loss and self-removal. This still enters actual prevention/rescue machinery.
power.watcher_end_turn_death_power.removal: Self-removal is requested by the start-turn callback. A debuff cleanse is not permission to remove this BUFF.
notes: Artifact does not prevent its BUFF application. Intangible, Buffer and rescue interact at damage-time boundaries, not merely when Blasphemy was played.
discrepancies: The wiki table labels Blasphemer Debuff. The existing Watcher draft explicitly reports EndTurnDeath inherits BUFF; practical harm and technical classification differ.

power.watcher_block_return_power.effect: When the afflicted enemy receives a qualifying attack callback, request the stacked Block amount for the player, not for the enemy carrying this power.
notes: The documented callback excludes THORNS/HP_LOSS, requires a nonnull different damage owner, and does not require positive unblocked damage. A fully blocked qualifying hit can request Block.
discrepancies: The wiki table labels Block Return Buff. The Watcher draft explicitly identifies the enemy-carried power as a stacking DEBUFF.

power.choke_power.effect: When the player uses a card, request the stacked amount of HP loss from the afflicted enemy carrying Choked.
power.choke_power.removal: The affected creature's start-turn callback requests removal; not a universal 'remove every temporary power at player end-turn' rule.
discrepancies: The wiki table labels Choked Buff; the Silent draft identifies Choked as a separate DEBUFF application.

power.corpse_explosion_power.amount: Multiplier of the owner's max HP captured at its qualifying death callback, not its current Poison or remaining HP.
notes: The documented callback uses null-owner THORNS damage and a monsters-basically-dead guard. Applying/cleansing Poison is independent of Corpse Explosion. Do not guarantee that every queued chained explosion survives terminal pruning.
discrepancies: The wiki table labels Corpse Explosion Buff; the Silent draft identifies its separate DEBUFF application.

power.watcher_energy_down_power.amount: Energy-loss intensity, separate from Fasting's Strength and Dexterity grants.
discrepancies: The wiki table labels Fasting Buff. The Watcher draft describes its EnergyDownPower as a separately preventable debuff, not the two preceding stat buffs.

notes: Panic Button's power suppresses calculated Block from cards, not raw power/orb/relic Block or Entrench's direct doubling path.
discrepancies: The Cargo table labels No Block Buff, while the wiki Debuffs page lists it as a debuff. Keep this source disagreement explicit; classification is not original-runtime validated.

power.wraith_form_power.amount: Signed amount, initially -1, controlling a recurring Dexterity change; separate from Intangible's duration.
power.wraith_form_power.effect: At the affected creature's end-turn, request Dexterity change equal to the signed Wraith Form amount.
power.wraith_form_power.removal: Intangible expiring does not remove this independently installed downside. Debuff prevention/cleansing applies separately.
discrepancies: The wiki table describes start-turn loss; the retained Silent draft describes an end-turn callback and signed negative amount. The draft's source grade is preserved, not promoted.

power.intangible_player_power.amount: Remaining player-side duration, not the damage ceiling.
power.intangible_player_power.turn_progression: The Silent draft reports player end-round reduction/removal; priority 75 on the final-receive modifier.
notes: Values above 1 are reduced to 1 on the documented path. Damage-time presence and other modifier order matter. Do not merge this ID or its lifecycle with the enemy variant.

power.reference.intangible_enemy.amount: Enemy-side Intangible duration/state; the exact constructor ID is not supplied by the retained catalog.
notes: Nemesis alternates turns with Intangible. The public description does not establish that enemy expiry is the same callback as IntangiblePlayer's player end-round path.

power.regen_power.amount: Player healing for the next eligible tick, reduced by one per turn.
power.regen_power.turn_progression: Request player healing and reduce the current Regen amount by one; healing modifiers/prevention remain separate.
power.regen_power.removal: Remove when its diminishing amount is spent; not the constant enemy regeneration lifecycle.

power.reference.regenerate.amount: Enemy HP healing per eligible end-turn; not a decreasing count of future turns.
power.reference.regenerate.turn_progression: Queue healing for a qualifying living/non-half-dead enemy without decrementing the regeneration amount.
discrepancies: The wiki table's BetweenTurns value 'Counter' must not import the player's decrementing Regen behavior into enemy regeneration.

power.reference.nightmare.amount: Number of copies from this power's independently captured card template.
power.reference.nightmare.removal: Start-turn requests template creation and removal; do not collapse different selected templates into one matching-ID intensity.
notes: The Silent draft explicitly excludes Night Terror from ordinary matching-ID stacking. A documented ID family is not permission to merge distinct live power objects.
discrepancies: The wiki's generic Intensity label does not describe the separate selected-template instances reported in the local draft.

power.the_bomb_power.amount: Countdown, initially 3; damage payload is a separate captured 40/50 value.
power.the_bomb_power.removal: Reduce each independently aged bomb; its final eligible callback requests detonation/removal. Do not merge ages or replace an earlier payload.
notes: The catalog literal TheBomb is a family identity, not proof that every live instance uses that exact unsuffixed string.
discrepancies: The wiki label 'Does not stack' must not be read as discarding extra casts; both the page and local draft describe separate bombs.

power.duplication_power.amount: Remaining repeat charges, consumed on qualifying card use and also subject to the retained end-of-round decay finding.
power.duplication_power.turn_progression: The retained potion draft reports end-of-round removal when already zero, otherwise reduction by one. Do not substitute either indefinite conservation or unconditional end-turn removal.
power.duplication_power.removal: Qualifying non-purge card uses consume charges; the local end-of-round path also removes/reduces. Detailed queue/reduction composition retains its existing evidence limits.
notes: The public potion tooltip says 'This turn', while the source-grounded local draft explicitly rejects unconditional end-turn removal. With multiple charges, a one-charge round reduction is not a blanket expiry of all unused charges.
discrepancies: Cargo BetweenTurns='Conserved' omits round decay; the captured Duplication Potion description says 'This turn'. The retained potion draft instead documents charge consumption plus end-of-round removal-if-zero/otherwise-reduce-one. All accounts remain explicit at their stated grades.

power.watcher_deva_power.amount: Growth increment, separate from the next energy gain.
power.watcher_deva_power.turn_progression: Grant g, then increase g by a. An additional stack increases a by the stack amount and g by 1, not necessarily by that amount.

power.reference.collect.amount: Remaining upgraded-Miracle recharge deliveries, not Miracles per delivery.
power.reference.collect.turn_progression: Request one Miracle+ per recharge, then reduce duration or remove when duration is at most 1.

power.panache_power.amount: Damage intensity; a separate counter starts/resets at five qualifying card uses.
notes: An installing Panache does not count its own earlier use retrospectively. Stacking increases damage without resetting the remaining counter; start-turn resets it to five.

power.combust_power.effect: At player end-turn, request grouped self HP loss, then non-Attack damage to all enemies, with separate self-loss and damage amounts.
power.combust_power.amount: Damage intensity; self-loss has its own counter increased by each stack call.
notes: One base plus one upgraded installation gives self-loss 2 and damage 12 in the local draft; it is not one HP per damage point.
discrepancies: The wiki table says lose X HP and leaves damage unquantified. The retained local finding separates the two stored quantities.

notes: The red/colorless draft describes queued draw before HP loss. Printed wording is not execution order.
discrepancies: The wiki description lists HP loss before draw; the retained draft describes queued draw then HP loss.

notes: Raw power Block, not card Block. The player-side retained hook precedes end-turn card payloads; do not infer one universal player/enemy scheduler from that finding.
The early hook queues deferred wrappers and nested top-card plays. Hook timing does not prove every child completes before normal draw. Free/autoplay is not a universal legality bypass.
Use qualified actual-character/healing-filter generator laws, not an inferred uniform draw over every colorless card. RNG-001 applies.

The retained callback excludes THORNS/HP_LOSS, requires a nonnull different attacker, and does not require positive unblocked damage. Fully blocked qualifying attacks still retaliate. This is per hit, unlike Sharp Hide's Attack-card use trigger.
A multi-hit Attack is one Attack-card play for Sharp Hide, not one trigger per damage hit. Guardian's state transition owns power installation/removal.

power.flame_barrier_power.removal: The retained next-player-start hook queues removal, not current-player-end removal.
notes: Requires a nonnull damage owner other than the power owner and a type other than THORNS/HP_LOSS.

power.static_discharge_power.effect: A qualifying on-attacked callback with positive damageAmount requests separate Lightning channels; final HP actually lost can be changed later.
notes: The local predicate requires positive callback damage, a nonnull different owner, and neither THORNS nor HP_LOSS. Later Tungsten Rod/loss changes need not retroactively cancel that trigger.
The retained predicate requires positive damageAmount, NORMAL damage and a target different from the power owner; separate hits remain separate callbacks.
This is not the same hook as Thousand Cuts' after-card-played callback. Its Block is raw power Block.
Requests non-Attack/THORNS all-enemy damage, not another Attack play.
The retained predicate uses positive loss and damage owner==player. Printed 'from a card' is not a complete causal-ancestry test; triggering once per HP point is incorrect.

power.retain_card_power.effect: At the player's retention checkpoint, allow up to the stacked amount of selected cards to be retained.
discrepancies: The wiki power description says start of turn. The card description and retained Silent retention finding describe end-turn selection, not a new start-turn choice.

power.energized_power.amount: Additional energy at the next qualified recharge; not turns of energy gain.
power.energized_power.removal: Gain the stored amount synchronously at recharge, then request removal.

notes: Separate ID from Energized; the common display concept is not permission to merge power identities.

power.draw_card_next_turn_power.removal: Append the additional draw request and self-removal at the qualified post-draw hook.

notes: Dodge and Roll captures calculated card Block at play time. Do not reapply next-turn Dexterity/Frail to that captured amount.
power.next_turn_block_power.removal: Request the stored Block and then removal at start-turn.

notes: Request stacked draw, then stacked selected discard; not multiple independent selections solely because the power stacked.
Requests a separate Double Damage power and reduces its own amount. Delayed Phantasmal and active Double Damage are not one power/lifetime.

power.reference.double_damage.amount: Duration; attacks multiply by two once, not by two repeatedly for every stack.

power.blur_power.amount: Duration; turn-start Block clearing tests presence rather than multiplying Block by the stack.

power.lock_on_power.amount: Duration; the orb-damage multiplier remains 1.5 regardless of stack count.
notes: Reapplications add duration on the ordinary path. Do not apply the Attack-specific Strength/Weak/Vulnerable/stance calculation to orb damage.
Check Calm at the qualified hook; this is raw power Block, not card Block.

power.watcher_mantra_power.amount: Progress toward the Divinity threshold of 10; separate from combat-total Mantra gained for Brilliance.
state: Separate combat-total accumulator belongs to combat history
notes: The Watcher draft describes special large/no-existing-Mantra application paths. Do not infer unbounded repeated Divinity entries from one large application or treat 10 as a universal cap on combat history.

Afflicted enemies each lose HP equal to their own Mark. Artifact can block the new selected application without preventing already-existing Marks elsewhere from triggering. This is HP_LOSS, not Attack damage.
The local action selects eligible hand instances with retain/selfRetain at execution. Runic Pyramid merely preventing discard is not itself Retain.
Request raw Block only for an actual stance transition; requesting the stance already active does not establish a change.
The draft permits the notification before an empty-pile return; 'discarded at least one card' is not the predicate.

power.watcher_free_attack_power.removal: Consume the qualifying entitlement when used; the Watcher draft reports no automatic turn-end expiry.
notes: A free entitlement is distinct from setting numeric turn/combat cost to zero, especially for X-cost cards.

power.reference.surrounded.effect: Player-side orientation/encounter indicator for the Shield/Spear fight. The supporting enemy page says this indicator does not itself add another damage bonus; keep the enemy Back Attack multiplier separate.
notes: Do not multiply incoming damage twice by implementing both a player Surrounded bonus and an enemy Back Attack bonus. Exact technical power type/constructor ID remain unverified in this dataset.
discrepancies: The generic module says receive 50% more damage; the enemy page explicitly calls Surrounded a telegraph rather than a second damage modifier.

power.reference.back_attack.amount: Conditional rear-attack multiplier/state, not a linear damage bonus per stack.
notes: Spire Shield/Spear orientation controls the condition. Treat the player-side Surrounded indicator separately, not as an additional multiplier.
The Heart's public page reports initial amount 1, or 2 at A19+, and later increases during its pattern. These are source-qualified scenario values, not one immutable amount for all encounters.
Preserve actual damage/prevention and death ordering; do not pre-debit hypothetical damage merely because an action is legal.

power.reference.invincible.amount: Remaining HP-loss quota for the relevant turn, distinct from the configured reset quota.
notes: The Heart page reports 300 HP per turn, or 200 at A19+. Vault skips the enemy turn/end-of-round phase, so do not assume every new player turn resets this quota.

power.reference.flying.amount: Remaining qualifying hits to knock down flight, not the reduction percentage.
notes: The Byrd page reports threshold 3, or 4 at A17+, and 50% Attack damage reduction. Indirect damage bypasses flight; grounded state changes the enemy's action sequence. Vault does not reset the counter.

The retained Buffs page explicitly describes a twelve-card threshold; the Time Eater power summary only says 'a certain number'. Preserve per-play counting and qualified forced-end-turn arbitration, including Vault/Omniscience exceptions; this is not an energy-payment limit.

power.reference.minion.amount: Encounter-role marker, not remaining turns or HP.
notes: Minion matters for Fatal exclusions. Encounter-specific death, queued suicide, escape and parent-cleanup behavior must not be replaced with a universal 'abandon combat' operation.
Awakened One's accompanying Cultists are not Minions merely because they flee after the boss dies.

The scoped Cultist finding suppresses its first end-of-round occurrence. Do not grant the first Dark Strike advance Strength or infer one identical first-application flag for every player/enemy producer.

Store the actual stolen card, not only its display name. Return-to-hand, overflow, actual-draw notifications and encounter settlement require the implementation's qualified lifecycle, not a generic new-card grant.
The Transient temporarily loses Strength proportional to HP lost; the restoration state is separate from its current Strength. Do not treat blocked nominal damage as HP loss.

power.reference.fading.amount: Remaining countdown to the Transient's exit/death behavior, not a beneficial damage intensity.
notes: Its BUFF label does not imply practical benefit or permission for a generic debuff cleanse to remove it. Exact terminal and reward handling belongs to the encounter.
The wiki's 'attack damage' summary is not a complete damage-owner/type predicate. Do not infer a universal HP_LOSS exclusion or one Wound per damage point without a qualified callback finding.
uncertainties: Exact source-attribution and damage-type/positive-loss predicate is not established by the retrieved tooltip.

notes: A qualifying Writhing Mass hit can change its live intent. Multi-hit attacks and subsequent choices must preserve the encounter's per-hit and history rules, not one reroll per card by assumption.

The Cargo row describes intensity reducing next-turn draw, while the broad Debuffs page describes one fewer draw for X turns. Preserve the disagreement instead of silently choosing a universal amount/duration law.
discrepancies: Cargo calls Draw Reduction intensity/'Draw X less cards next turn'; Debuffs calls it duration/'Draw 1 less card for the next X turns'. Constructor/stack/lifecycle details remain unresolved here.

notes: The player carries this enemy-applied debuff. It creates Dazed; created/moved cards are not automatically actual draws.
The player, not Spire Growth, carries the damage-producing debuff. Preserve actual damage/block/prevention and owner/removal linkage; the tooltip does not establish all source-death interactions.

power.reference.explosive.amount: Countdown; the explosion payload and enemy lifecycle are separate state.
notes: Do not interpret the wiki's unspecified 'some amount' as zero damage. The Shapes/Exploder encounter owns its damage and suicide/settlement order.
Half-death and final group defeat are distinct. Fatal and rewards must not trigger on every temporary Darkling downing; a pending revive is not ordinary death followed by a fresh unrelated spawn.
Its increasing within-turn Block response is not merely a permanent linear stack count. Exact qualifying hit predicate and reset checkpoint need the named owner path.
Guardian tracks a quota and queues a mode transition/Block gain. Crossing the threshold is not permission to replace every later move synchronously or lose subsequent hit callbacks.
The Fungi Beast finding checks battle-ending/group state and may suppress a final-enemy cloud. It is not a post-fight debuff grant after every Fungi death.
Prevents actual additional draws; it does not forbid creation/retrieval into hand or cancel already requested unrelated shuffles.
Skill free-payment/cost treatment and exhaust-on-use are separate from turning every negative cost into zero. Status/Curse cards retain their own types; the power itself leaving play is not Exhaust.
Separate repeat count/history and original captured X are required. Do not recursively repeat purge copies or double only the first card forever regardless of stacked intensity.

Offers, chosen copies, hand actions, overflow and animation/stored objects have different upgrade checkpoints. Do not replace the qualified routes with one universal constructor upgrade; Wish's option callbacks are not physical acquired cards.
